notes.text:
TEST 1 - INSERT BEFORE A TUNNEL
On the upper Gaussian Blur, right-click the 'Shared processed image' badge. Choose Insert node before 'Shared processed image'..., then choose Invert. PASS: Invert appears before the tunnel, both upper threshold nodes still use it, and the separate Rescale Intensity wire is unchanged.

ALTERNATIVE FOR TEST 1 - DRAG THE LOOSE NODE
If you already completed Test 1, undo it first. Drag this unconnected Invert node onto the 'Shared processed image' badge and release when the badge highlights. PASS: it is inserted before the tunnel in one step. Undo when finished.

TEST 2 - COPY SETTINGS
Click the lower-left Gaussian Blur (sigma 4.0) and press Ctrl+C. First right-click a threshold node: Paste values should be unavailable there. Then right-click the lower-right Gaussian Blur (sigma 0.6) and choose Paste values from Gaussian Blur. PASS: sigma becomes 4.0, while its position and wires stay unchanged.

TEST 3 - COPY TWO CONNECTED NODES
Click Unsharp Mask, then hold Ctrl and click Binary Threshold. Press Ctrl+C, click blank canvas, then press Ctrl+V. PASS: one new copy of each appears near the centre, joined by one wire. Drag either new node: both selected copies move together.

TEST 4 - PASTE LOCATION AND UNDO
With the two nodes still copied, right-click empty canvas and choose Paste nodes here. PASS: the pair appears at that spot. Press Ctrl+Z once: the whole pair disappears. Press Ctrl+Y: it returns. Press Ctrl+V twice more: repeated copies should be slightly offset.

TEST 5 - MAKE GAUSSIAN GPU ELIGIBLE
This test needs a qualified GPU setup; it is not offered on a CPU-only system. Select the upper Gaussian Blur. VIPP should explain that its uint16 input is the only GPU blocker. Click Add conversion. PASS: a visible Convert Dtype node appears between the Image Source and Gaussian Blur, set to float32 and Preserve. The message now says GPU eligible, not guaranteed. Undo once to remove the whole change.
